summary: National Grid plc filed a Form 6-K containing three routine announcements to the London Stock Exchange: a monthly total voting rights update as of 31 March 2026, and two PDMR share transaction notifications under MAR. The voting rights update states 4,973,426,832 ordinary shares with voting rights outstanding. The PDMR notices disclose a CFO's monthly partnership share purchase at GBP 13.1892 and an automatic dividend reinvestment. These are ordinary regulatory disclosures, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is announced.
